source.note: Full text of ASME BPVC Section II, Part B (Nonferrous Material Specifications) — Nonmandatory Appendix A - Sources of Standards — as supplied by Daniel Velasquez on 2026-09-07 and extracted from the supplied PDF with marker-pdf. `data` is the extractor's output verbatim — the drop's own `document`, `part`, `figures` and `pages` blocks, with the page-by-page block tree, its HTML, tables and layout coordinates unedited. This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages 1316–1317, printed pages 1267–1268) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.B-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.
